Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly stated that the Scottish Parliament has been based at The Mound since 2004. In reality, The Mound (General Assembly Hall) was a temporary venue from 1999 to 2004; since 2004 the modern equivalent—the Scottish Parliament—has been based at the Scottish Parliament Building at Holyrood. This factual error led to the wrong final answer.
